note: Santa Clara County park of redwood and tanoak in the Santa Cruz Mountains above Saratoga, with 22 miles of trails and summer Shakespeare in the park. The RV campground is a single paved row of back-in sites at the south edge of the main meadow; RV sites only (no tents, and no car camping anywhere in the park), and an RV must use both the water and electric hookups. The gate closes at sunset; campers get the combination. The hike-in tent camps close from late October to late March. --Claude

Hookups were stored as none - corrected. Pin ~345 m off (woods by the entrance road) -> RV row.
